questions.question: What will be opened in Zechariah 13 to cleanse from sin?
options: A great throne set up for the house of David
A fountain for the house of David and Jerusalem
A high wall built all around the house of David
A great famine sent upon the house of David
questions.answer: A fountain for the house of David and Jerusalem

questions.question: What does God say about striking the shepherd in Zechariah 13?
options: Guard the flock, and the wolves will flee
Gather the flock, and the shepherd will rejoice
Feed the whole flock, and the shepherd will grow very rich
Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered
questions.answer: Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered

questions.question: Zechariah 13 speaks of a remnant, a third, being refined like silver and tested like gold.
On that day there shall be a _____ opened for the house of David to cleanse them from sin.
Strike the shepherd, and the _____ will be scattered.
